cases.question: Who pays customs duties on an international order?

*   For defective or wrong item returns, the original import duties paid are also not refunded by ShopSmart (international_shipping.html).

If you wish to reclaim duties on a return shipment, you should contact your national customs authority, as many countries have a duty drawback scheme (international_shipping.html).
